fullContent:
Bhadradarvadi Kashayam 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam. 
 Bhadradarvadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine available in the herbal decoction form. It is used for the treatment of asthma, cough, rheumatoid arthritis etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Devedaru ( Cedrus deodara ) 
 Tagara ( Valeriana wallichi ) 
 Kusta (Saussurea lappa) 
 Bala ( Sida rhombifolia ) 
 Athibala ( Abutilon indicum ) 
 Dashamula – group of 10 herbs:- 
 
 
 Bilva – Aegle marmelos 
 Agnimantha – Premna mucronata 
 Shyonaka – Oroxylum indicum 
 Patala – Stereospermum suaveolens 
 Gambhari – Gmelina arborea 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Shalaparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Prishnaparni – Uraria picta 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Coarse powder (1 part) of all the above mentioned ingredients is boiled in 16 parts of water until it reduced to quarter part. 
 Dosage 
 Take 5-15 ml diluted with 15-45 ml of water twice daily before food or as directed by the physician. 
 Indications 
 
 Inflammatory conditions 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Osteoarthritis 
 General body ache 
 Asthma 
 Cough 
 Hiccups 
 joint pains 
 Muscle wasting 
 Inflammatory conditions 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects. Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 Over-dosage may result in gastric irritation. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
